items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I remember one time we had Charlie Christian upstairs, right? And so I started calling the guys, and we started jamming

ctx.x: Let me ask you something -- you said you were in trouble for jamming. Didn't the union have -- I know later, the union had a rule that if you pay a basic rhythm section or if you pay 3 musicians -- a leader and 2 others -- then you can get permission to have a jam session where everybody isn't paid. Was that in effect then?
No, that came much later ... but I'll
tell you how that came about. That was forced. We forced their hands, and I'm still talking about the separate unions now.
